arguments.summary: A PrintNightmare (CVE-2025-31337) variant was used by an adversary from internal host 10.0.5.14 to exploit a print spooler service on 10.0.7.33, achieving SYSTEM privileges and creating a Kerberos Golden Ticket via krbtgt hash theft. Containment actions included isolation of the compromised endpoints, revocation of privileged sessions, disabling of Kerberos delegation trusts, emergency rotation of the krbtgt account, and patching of the vulnerability. The incident was classified as high severity.
